summary: Grays Harbor County tower on Weyerhaeuser land, said to date from the 1930s and be abandoned in the 1940s; the summit held radio equipment on a February 2021 visit and is reached by permit.

access.note: Private Weyerhaeuser land; recreational access is by permit through a gate to the north. The direct highway route is posted No Trespassing because of an active quarry.

visit.trail_note: Permit required; use the gate to the north, not the highway route, which is posted No Trespassing

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s and gone, per the register; the summit had communications equipment on a February 2021 visit, and access is by permit

events.note: Sources give only 'the 1930s'; 1930 stands in for the decade and is not a dated record
Sources give only 'the 1940s'; 1940 stands in for the decade and is not a dated record
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on February 11, 2020

notes_for_editor: Every claim about the tower rests on one undated report; WillhiteWeb says the firelookout.com listing has an unknown source and that the tower's location on the summit is unknown. The 1930 and 1940 event years are placeholders for decades, not dates, and the story says so. The record's agency spelling is wrong; the correction proposes the spelling used by WillhiteWeb. Staffing is not described in any source read. Access is by permit on private land; this page does not encourage visits without permission.
